title: The best AI tools for Airbnb hosts in 2026, by job
summary: The best AI tools for Airbnb hosts in 2026 for guest messaging, calls, pricing, cleanings, reviews and research, and what each does without you.
body_markdown:
**The AI tools worth paying for as an Airbnb host do one of five jobs: answer guests, set prices, run turnovers, protect reviews, or write and research for you. You don't need one of each. Most hosts get the biggest return from an AI that answers guest messages, because that's the work that never stops, and from dynamic pricing, because that's the work most hosts don't do at all. This guide covers the best tool for each job in 2026 and what each one actually does without you.**


We make ProhostAI, which is on this list. We've tried to be fair to every tool, including the ones we compete with, and to say who each one is genuinely best for. Pricing was checked on vendor sites in November 2026. Where a vendor doesn't publish a price, we say so.


## Key takeaways


- **Start with guest messaging.** It's the highest-volume work in hosting. The typical ProhostAI customer has AI handle about **61% of guest messages** on its own, and median first reply time drops from about 11 minutes to 6.5 ([our data](https://prohost.ai/blog/does-ai-make-better-hosts) ).
- **Dynamic pricing is the second-biggest lever.** PriceLabs, Wheelhouse and Beyond adjust your nightly rate every day from market demand. ChatGPT can't do this for you.
- **Operations AI matters once you have a team.** Tools that turn guest messages into tasks and schedule cleanings from checkouts save the most time at 10+ listings.
- **General chatbots are useful but limited.** ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini are good at listing copy and house rules. They can't see your bookings or reply to guests on Airbnb.
- **Check what the AI does without you.** "AI-powered" often means "suggests a draft." Ask each vendor which jobs it finishes on its own.

## 1. AI for guest messaging: ProhostAI


**Best for:** hosts with more than a couple of listings who want AI to answer guests on its own, not only suggest drafts.


ProhostAI connects to Airbnb directly or through your PMS (Hostaway, Guesty, Hospitable, OwnerRez, Lodgify, Smoobu, Beds24) and imports your full message history. It learns your properties and your tone from that history, then replies to guests in your voice. You choose how much to hand over: **Suggestions** puts a draft in front of you for every message, and **Autopilot** sends on its own when it's confident and asks you when it isn't. AI Memory keeps learning from your edits, so you don't have to write a knowledge base first.


What we see in our data: the typical customer has AI handle about 61% of guest messages, most land between 44% and 72%, and guest communication ratings rose from 4.77 to 4.86 after switching on ([full study](https://prohost.ai/blog/does-ai-make-better-hosts) ).


- **Pricing:** the all-in-one plan is $15 per property per month (minimum $30), including messaging, cleanings, tasks, reviews, guidebooks and upsells. See[plans](https://prohost.ai/plans) .
- **Not the best fit if:** you have one listing and get a handful of messages a week. Airbnb's own scheduled messages and quick replies may be enough.


More:[AI messaging](https://prohost.ai/messaging) .


**Alternatives worth a look:**


- **Hospitable** is a PMS with AI built in. If you want your PMS and AI from one vendor and you're starting fresh, it's a strong choice. Its free Essentials plan includes a limited number of AI-suggested replies; fuller AI is on the paid tiers.[How we compare](https://prohost.ai/vs/hospitable-ai) .
- **HostBuddy AI** is a focused AI messaging layer that sits on top of your PMS, with per-property tiers and a free trial. Good if messaging is the only gap in your stack.[How we compare](https://prohost.ai/vs/hostbuddy) .


For a deeper comparison, see our guide to[AI guest messaging software](https://prohost.ai/blog/best-ai-guest-messaging-software-for-short-term-rentals) .


## 2. AI for phone calls: ProhostAI AI Phone


**Best for:** hosts and managers whose guests, owners or cleaners still call.


Many guests call when something is urgent: a lockout, a late arrival, a broken heater. An AI receptionist answers every call with your property knowledge, can follow up by text, and hands the call to a person or an AI employee by rules you set. Every call is recorded, transcribed and summarized next to the guest's conversation.


- **Pricing:** AI Phone plans start at $30 per month, with a pool of credits shared between calls and texts. See[AI Phone](https://prohost.ai/ai-phone) .
- **Alternative:** Conduit includes voice in its AI agent platform from its $18 per unit per month Messaging plan. More in our guide to[AI phone answering for vacation rentals](https://prohost.ai/blog/best-ai-phone-answering-for-vacation-rentals) .


## 3. AI for pricing: PriceLabs


**Best for:** almost every host who isn't already using dynamic pricing.


PriceLabs sets your nightly rate every day based on demand in your market: seasonality, events, booking pace and what nearby listings charge. You set minimums, maximums and rules (minimum stays, orphan-night discounts, last-minute changes) and it pushes prices to Airbnb or your PMS. It also sells market dashboards for research.


- **Alternatives:** **Wheelhouse** offers more control over pricing strategy and transparent recommendations. **Beyond** is popular with hosts who want a hands-off setup. All three are priced per listing; check their sites for current rates.
- **Works with ProhostAI:** ProhostAI connects to[PriceLabs](https://prohost.ai/integrations/pricelabs) and[Beyond](https://prohost.ai/integrations/beyond) , so you can see pricing alongside your calendar and guest conversations.


## 4. AI for cleanings and operations: ProhostAI, Turno, Breezeway


**Best for:** anyone with a cleaner, a handyman or a co-host.


The time sink in operations isn't the clean itself; it's noticing what needs doing. ProhostAI schedules turnover cleanings from checkouts, auto-assigns them, and reads guest messages and reviews to create maintenance tasks on its own ("the shower drain was slow" becomes a task with the listing and photo attached).


- **Turno** is the best-known cleaning scheduler, with a marketplace for finding cleaners and built-in cleaner payments. Pick it if finding and paying cleaners is your main problem.[How we compare](https://prohost.ai/vs/turno) .
- **Breezeway** goes deepest on field operations: inspections, maintenance, inventory and owner reports. Pick it if you run a large field team.[How we compare](https://prohost.ai/vs/breezeway) .


More: our guides to[task management software](https://prohost.ai/blog/best-task-management-software-for-short-term-rentals) and[cleaning scheduling software](https://prohost.ai/blog/best-cleaning-scheduling-software-for-short-term-rentals) .


## 5. AI for reviews: ProhostAI


**Best for:** hosts who want more reviews and fewer surprises in them.


Most hosts collect a review on only about 4 in 10 stays, and the difference is mostly whether the guest gets asked ([our study of a quarter-million stays](https://prohost.ai/blog/how-to-get-more-5-star-reviews) ). ProhostAI asks every guest at the right moment, writes your review of the guest, drafts responses to reviews, and turns complaints in reviews into maintenance tasks. When a review breaks Airbnb's rules, its dispute builder helps you make the case ([how to remove an Airbnb review](https://prohost.ai/blog/how-to-remove-airbnb-review) ).


Hosts who turn on ProhostAI's review tools collect reviews on about **48% of stays, compared with 33%** for those who don't.


More:[AI reviews](https://prohost.ai/features/reviews) .


## 6. AI for market research: AirDNA


**Best for:** buying a new property or deciding where to expand.


AirDNA estimates occupancy, average daily rate and revenue for any market and for individual comparable listings. It's the standard tool for underwriting a purchase. PriceLabs' market dashboards are a cheaper alternative if you already use PriceLabs. Our free[Airbnb profit calculator](https://prohost.ai/tools/airbnb-profit-calculator) is a quick first pass.


## 7. General AI assistants: ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini


**Best for:** listing descriptions, house rules, welcome guides and one-off writing.


General chatbots are good writers. Give them your property details and ask for a listing description, a house manual or a polite reply to a difficult guest, and you'll get a solid first draft. Their limit is that they can't see your calendar or your inbox, and they can't send anything to Airbnb. Use them for writing; use a connected tool for the daily work.


A few prompts that work well:


- "Write an Airbnb listing description for a 3-bedroom cabin near Big Bear. Lead with the hot tub and the view. Under 500 characters for the summary."
- "Turn these notes into a house manual with sections for arrival, Wi-Fi, appliances, trash and checkout."
- "A guest says the cabin was dirty. Here are the cleaner's photos. Write a calm, factual reply."


## How to choose your AI stack


- **1–3 listings:** dynamic pricing (PriceLabs or Wheelhouse) plus a general AI assistant for writing. Add AI messaging once messages start interrupting your day.
- **4–20 listings:** AI guest messaging with autopilot, dynamic pricing, and automatic cleaning scheduling. This is where hosts save the most time.
- **20+ listings or a team:** add AI that creates tasks from guest messages, an AI phone line, and review automation. One connected workspace beats five tools that don't talk to each other.


## Frequently asked questions


**What is the best AI tool for Airbnb hosts?**
It depends on the job. For guest messaging, ProhostAI, Hospitable and HostBuddy AI are the most-used options. For pricing, PriceLabs, Wheelhouse and Beyond. For cleaning, Turno and Breezeway. Most hosts start with messaging and pricing.


**Can AI reply to Airbnb guests automatically?**
Yes. Tools like ProhostAI connect to Airbnb or your PMS and reply to guests in your voice. The good ones send on their own only when they're confident and ask you when they aren't.


**Is ChatGPT good for Airbnb hosting?**
For writing, yes: listing descriptions, house rules and replies you paste yourself. It can't see your bookings or message guests on Airbnb, so it doesn't replace a connected tool.


**Does Airbnb allow AI messaging tools?**
Airbnb works with approved software partners and PMS platforms, which is how tools like ProhostAI and Hospitable connect. You stay responsible for what's sent, which is why we recommend starting in Suggestions mode before turning on Autopilot.


**How much do AI tools for Airbnb hosts cost?**
Most are priced per listing per month. ProhostAI's all-in-one plan is $15 per property per month. Dynamic pricing tools are also priced per listing. Some tools, like Hospitable's Essentials plan, have a free tier.
